en.headline: Tang says restricted management at Huanggang port maximises limited space
en.dek: Security Bureau chief says the Hong Kong side of the rebuilt port uses closed-area controls like other land borders, with weekday crossings averaging over 86,000.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang told the Legislative Council that the Hong Kong side of the rebuilt Huanggang Port operates under restricted-area management, the same approach used at the former Lok Ma Chau Control Point and other land border crossings.

Tang said only cross-boundary vehicles holding valid closed-road permits, plus designated public transport including franchised buses, green minibuses and taxis from urban and New Territories fleets, may enter the Hong Kong port area. He described this as the most effective way to use the limited space available and confirmed there is no general private-car drop-off or pick-up zone inside the port area.

According to the written reply, the port has 134 collaborative-inspection e-channels and 68 traditional manual counters. Average daily passenger crossings on weekdays have exceeded 86,000 since opening, more than double the previous Lok Ma Chau figure, while weekends and holidays approach 140,000.

Tang added that a passenger hall has been reserved for the future Northern Link spur line, which is planned to connect directly into the port under the one-land-two-checks arrangement and open no later than 2034 together with the main line. The government continues to work with the MTR Corporation on innovative techniques to bring the project forward.

zh.headline: 鄧炳強指皇崗口岸港方禁區式管理最有效運用有限空間
zh.dek: 保安局局長表示，重建後皇崗口岸港方口岸區實施禁區式管理，平日日均出入境人次平均超過8萬6千人。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強書面回覆立法會質詢時表示，重建後皇崗口岸的港方口岸區實施禁區式管理，一如原落馬洲管制站及其他陸路邊境管制站。
鄧炳強指，只有持有效封閉道路通行證的跨境車輛，以及指定的公共運輸服務車輛（包括專營巴士、專線小巴及市區及新界的士車隊的士），方可進入港方口岸區。他認為這是最有效運用港方口岸區內有限空間的做法，口岸區內並沒有設置一般私家車的上落客區。
回覆指，皇崗口岸共設有134條合作查驗自助通道及68個傳統人工櫃柳。口岸開通至今，平日的日均出入境總人次平均超過8萬6千人，較以往落馬洲管制站增加超過一倍；周末及假期的日均出入境總人次接近14萬。
鄧炳強又表示，皇崗口岸已預留接駁北環線支線的旅客出入境大堂，未來北環線支線會直接接入口岸，加上「一地兩檢」安排，將可連通港深地鐵網絡。支線與主線計劃2034年或之前同步開通，政府會繼續與港鐵公司利用創新技術提速提效。
